title: Specialist Food and Drink Export Consultancy
description: The requirement is to appoint up to six suppliers to deliver Specialist Food and Drink Export Consultancy and Trade Development Visits. Successful suppliers will deliver specialist export advisory support to Welsh-based food and drink business to develop their international sales, and to help maximise their chances of export success.

title: Rough Sleeping Prevention Service
description: To prevent or minimise rough sleeping for people who are new to, or at imminent risk of rough sleeping on the streets in Bristol. To provide support to secure sustainable accommodation away from the streets or reconnection to another suitable place.
